title: Workplace access / pass exit
summary: Leaving a Singapore employer with building access cards, office car-park labels, VPN tokens, and visitor apps still live — return clocks, deposit holds, and how workplace exit collides with EP cancel and clinic deposit cash.

sections.title: Inventory every workplace access artefact
sections.body: Office tower cards, floor fobs, locker keys, car-park labels, VPN hardware tokens, and visitor-invite admin rights often sit on different desks — facilities, IT, and HR. EP cancel does not auto-collect them. List every item the week you resign, not the morning of your last day.
bullets: Photograph card serials and car-park label numbers
List VPN tokens, RSA keys, and admin roles on visitor apps
Ask facilities for the published return checklist and deposit amounts

sections.title: Match returns to facilities office hours
sections.body: Many towers only process card deactivation and deposit refunds on weekday office hours. Friday flights and diplomatic-clause exits collide with closed counters. Schedule card and label return before movers day — not after the last Grab to Changi.
bullets: Confirm facilities hours and required ID (passport + company letter)
Ask whether cards must be returned in person vs via HR
Get written confirmation of what deposits facilities vs HR holds

sections.title: IT tokens and visitor-app admins
sections.body: Hardware VPN tokens and visitor-invite admin rights can outlive your last working day if IT only closes email. Hand tokens back with a dated IT ticket, and remove yourself as visitor-host admin so ex-colleagues cannot keep issuing lobby QR under your name.
bullets: Return hardware tokens with an IT acknowledgement
Revoke visitor-host / meeting-room booking admin before Singpass changes
Export expense and medical claims PDFs while SSO still works

sections.title: Same-week stack with EP cancel and clinic cash
sections.body: Access-card return, EP cancel paperwork, and clinic / dental deposit refunds often land in one fortnight. Sequence so you still have building access on the day HR needs wet-ink signatures, and so workplace deposits are not raided by a clinic deposit float.
bullets: Put card return, HR wet-ink day, and clinic settlement on one calendar
Keep one adult free for tower facilities hours on exit week

sections.title: Office car-park labels vs personal IU
sections.body: Workplace car-park labels are not the same as your personal IU / ERP rail. Returning an office label does not deregister the car’s IU. Treat office parking deposits as a separate cash line from condo season parking or IU auto-top-up.
bullets: Return office labels to facilities — do not leave them with the next driver informally
Confirm whether unpaid office parking charges hit your final payslip
Pair personal IU / ERP exit with /journeys/parking-iu-erp-exit when that playbook is on main

sections.title: Cash float: access deposits vs clinic deposits
sections.body: Access-card deposits and clinic / dental deposits are small next to IR21 withhold — but they hit while movers cash is live. Keep a dedicated SGD float so a lost-card fee does not raid the clinic refund pot.
bullets: Total open facilities deposits before resignation week
Pay any lost-card fees while Singapore cards and PayNow still work
